description: Angular component for a markdown editor with Ace integration, including resize handling and control value accessor implementation.

classes.name: MarkdownEditorComponent
classes.description: Angular component providing a markdown editor with Ace integration, resize handling, and form control support.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the Ace editor if not readonly, sets up resize observer and event handlers.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resize observer, animation frame, and destroys Ace editor instance.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for value change propagation.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Sets the disabled state of the component.

methods.name: onFullscreen
methods.description: Resizes the editor when toggling fullscreen mode.

methods.name: toggleEditMode
methods.description: Switches between edit and view modes, resizing editor if needed.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Updates internal value and propagates change when editor content changes.

methods.name: onAceEditorResize
methods.description: Handles resize events for the Ace editor, scheduling resize via RafService.
